nodes.name: Cal.com Webhook
nodes.notes: responseMode=onReceived auto-responde 200 OK a Cal.com. El flujo continúa en segundo plano.

parameters.query: INSERT INTO leads (phone_number, full_name, email) VALUES (COALESCE(NULLIF('{{ $json.patientPhone }}', ''), 'cal_' || gen_random_uuid()::text), '{{ $json.patientName }}', NULLIF('{{ $json.patientEmail }}', '')) ON CONFLICT (phone_number) DO UPDATE SET full_name = EXCLUDED.full_name, email = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.email, leads.email), updated_at = NOW() RETURNING id;

INSERT INTO appointments (lead_id, cal_booking_id, cal_event_type_id, start_time, end_time, status, appointment_type, patient_name, patient_email, patient_phone, reason_for_visit, is_first_visit, channel, reschedule_count) VALUES ('{{ $('Upsert Lead').first().json.id }}', NULLIF('{{ $('Parse Cal.com Payload').first().json.calBookingId }}', ''), {{ $('Parse Cal.com Payload').first().json.calEventTypeId || 'NULL' }}, '{{ $('Parse Cal.com Payload').first().json.startTime }}', '{{ $('Parse Cal.com Payload').first().json.endTime }}', '{{ $('Parse Cal.com Payload').first().json.status }}', '{{ $('Parse Cal.com Payload').first().json.appointmentType }}', '{{ $('Parse Cal.com Payload').first().json.patientName }}', NULLIF('{{ $('Parse Cal.com Payload').first().json.patientEmail }}', ''), NULLIF('{{ $('Parse Cal.com Payload').first().json.patientPhone }}', ''), NULLIF('{{ $('Parse Cal.com Payload').first().json.reasonForVisit }}', ''), {{ $('Parse Cal.com Payload').first().json.isFirstVisit }}, 'cal', 0) ON CONFLICT (cal_booking_id) DO UPDATE SET status = EXCLUDED.status, reschedule_count = appointments.reschedule_count + CASE WHEN EXCLUDED.status = 'RESCHEDULED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, start_time = EXCLUDED.start_time, end_time = EXCLUDED.end_time;
